A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and technical appendices. v3 retains the scientific sections of v2 and appends a NeurIPS checklist. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original low-rank training experiments on vision benchmarks, GLUE, BoolQ, PIQA, and OpenWebText, including additional experiments in Section 10.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in the main text and technical appendices, despite adding no new experiments.

M1.justification: The proposed low-rank heavy-ball and Adam procedures, including basis augmentation, momentum projection, and truncation, are unchanged. Algorithm 4 only clarifies the reference Adam algorithm's input descriptions; its update steps remain identical.

E1.justification: The same vision, GLUE, reasoning, and language-modeling tasks are evaluated, including the appendix experiments. Table 1 changes its description from pretraining to compressed transfer learning, matching the pretrained initialization already documented in v2 rather than introducing different coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the corresponding experiments: full-rank training, LoRA variants, naive DLRT, and the GLUE adapter, BitFit, AdaLoRA, and GeoLoRA comparisons are retained. No evaluated comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Model configurations, preprocessing, metrics, and training budgets remain unchanged. Figure 4 loses the caption phrase '450 epochs', but its axes remain identical and Tables 4 and 13 retain the same 15,000-iteration GPT-2 budget; no replacement experimental protocol is reported.

E4.justification: The comparison testing momentum projection against naive DLRT and the long-term ViT-small convergence analysis in Section 10.1.7 and Figure 3 are retained unchanged. No new ablations, robustness tests, sensitivity analyses, or case studies appear.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains means and standard deviations over ten runs, while Table 2 and Figure 3 retain their five-run median reporting. The added checklist summarizes existing uncertainty reporting without adding run counts, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Compression percentages are corrected in Tables 3 and 4. Table 3 changes Algorithm 2's BoolQ/PIQA entries from 0.270%/0.247% to 99.73%/99.75%, with corresponding complement corrections for LoRA. Table 4 changes Algorithm 2 from 39.39% to 60.61% and LoRA Pretrain from 39.21% to 60.79%. These align reporting with the existing compression definition; accuracy, loss, runtime, and plotted results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical development and Theorems 1–4, including their assumptions and proofs in Section 9, are unchanged. Algorithm 4's dimensional annotations and explicit positive stability constant clarify standard notation without introducing new mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about geometry-aware momentum optimization, rank adaptation, joint compression, and empirical performance. Corrected compression entries do not redefine the main contributions.

C2.justification: The explanations of optimizer behavior, convergence, and accuracy–compression tradeoffs remain unchanged. The checklist points back to existing theorem assumptions and conclusions without adding substantive limitations or new interpretations of results.

D1.justification: A new GPT-2 footnote states that approximately 31% of parameters are in the head. The checklist newly discloses that open code access is not provided and promises release upon acceptance; it does not establish an actual release. Algorithm 4 also clarifies input dimensions. Hyperparameters and hardware disclosures are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 43 references and the same positioning relative to DLRT, LoRA, and optimizer-state compression methods are retained. Administrative policy links in the new checklist do not expand scientific related work.

P1.justification: v3 appends a NeurIPS checklist, expands funding acknowledgements, and makes localized affiliation, caption, and algorithm-input wording edits. The scientific narrative and ordering of Sections 1–10 remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains bold emphasis and a corrected caption; Figure 4's caption drops '450 epochs'. Algorithm 4 becomes slightly shorter, and added footnote text shifts the conclusion across a page boundary. Existing figures, plotted curves, and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: Correcting Tables 3–4 to match the stated compression definition and identifying Table 1 accurately as transfer learning improve reporting accuracy and interpretation. The scientific evidence remains unchanged. The added checklist retains unnecessary template instructions, limiting the editorial benefit, but the concrete reporting corrections support a modest net improvement.
